unit_of_analysis: public web surface observed by the MAR controlled discovery protocol
selection_rule: Collect a deterministic bounded crawl from six active corpora that were not used in either prior M3 human-review set. Preserve discovery order and include eligible observed surfaces without selecting or balancing units using M3 predictions. Exclude every URL from the 17-unit calibration set and the 33-unit independent validation of protocol 2.0.0 before predictions are generated.
prediction_freeze_rule: Automatic predictions and the blinded review queue must be materialized and SHA-256 hashed before any human review unit is opened.
blinding_rule: The human reviewer must not see predicted_surface_type, predicted_item_level, prediction_confidence, prediction_evidence, predicted_access_state or predicted_access_evidence until the human review artifact is closed.

evaluation_plan.primary: multiclass surface-role confusion matrix and per-class precision, recall and F1 on the new ecological sample
evaluation_plan.secondary: binary item-level versus non-item-level precision, recall, F1, specificity and accuracy
evaluation_plan.access_dimension: compare access-state agreement separately from semantic surface role
evaluation_plan.rare_class_policy: Classes absent or too sparse in the ecological sample will not receive generalized performance claims; targeted challenge sets, if later created, must be reported separately.

acceptance_guidance.fine_grained_surface_typing: No single aggregate threshold is sufficient; inspect multiclass confusion, per-class support and systematic entity-specific errors.
acceptance_guidance.item_level_gate: Binary item-level recall and false-positive behaviour must be materially improved over protocol 2.0.0 before M4 is scaled.
acceptance_guidance.access_state: Access-state agreement remains a separate diagnostic dimension and cannot compensate for semantic-role errors.

stop_rule: Do not modify protocol 2.1.0 after automatic predictions are frozen. Any defect discovered after freeze is a validation finding and may only be corrected in a later protocol version.
prohibited_interpretations: the sample is not a prevalence sample
the 50 known development units cannot be reported as independent performance evidence for protocol 2.1.0
collector access failures are not scientific negatives
validation of M3 surface typing does not establish corpus membership, institutional AI use or AI participation in audiovisual content
successful regression on known cases does not substitute for this independent validation
